title: The Understudy WIP
description: Work-in-progress build of The Understudy, a new playable character for Slay the Spire 2. Shared for friend testing. Requires BaseLib.
changeNote: v1.13.58: Applying Planned now always asks you to pick the cards (and their order), even when there are only a few eligible - Planned is order-sensitive, so it's never auto-applied. Auto-apply-when-few now only happens for Tuned (and Stable), which don't care about order.
